messages:
maya-cs: Quick heads-up — AtlasCorp reserved pool priming tomorrow 08:00 PST. We need a finalized quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a short rollback play. Can @sam-eng and @anika-ml confirm loadtest window and script by EOD?

sam-eng: Yep, I can take the loadscript. Planning a stepped soak: 50 -> 200 -> 500 qps, 10m per step. Will attach script.

anika-ml: I’ll validate model variant selection and confirm cache warmup strategy. Suggest prefix caching for the common 3 prompts.

maya-cs: Thanks. Julian from Atlas — do you have traffic heatmap (hourly distribution + tail latency targets) so we can map steps to real usage?

julian-customer: attaching summary: peak at 11:00 PST, 60% of traffic in 2-hour window. SLA target p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms. We expect a steady background of low-qps inference from internal users.

sam-eng: copying plan here:
```bash
heyperf run \  
  --target http://redwood-dedicated.atlascorp.local/generate \  
  --concurrency 250 \  
  --ramp 5m \  
  --duration 30m \  
  --model redwood-tuned-1 \  
  --headers "Authorization: Bearer $RESERVED_TOKEN"
```
This will simulate steady-state; I’ll add the stepped job as a separate stage.

ben-platform: For autoscaling, recommend: min_replicas=2, target_latency_slo_ms=300, scale_out_threshold=0.65 (GPU util), scale_in_threshold=0.35. Also enable burst-capacity policy to allow +1 replica for 15m on sustained queue growth.

anika-ml: On model side: we’ll use quantized v1.2 for cost predictability. I’ll seed KV cache with the top 50 prefixes 30m before the test. That should cut cold-start tokens by ~18%.

maya-cs: Risk checklist: 1) Token quota exhaustion — need explicit quota bump for reserved token for the run. 2) Fallback routing — if p99 > 1.2s, route to cheaper variant in eu-west as fallback. 3) Observability hooks — ensure tracing enabled.

sam-eng: Noted. I need the quota bump request submitted to billing by 17:00 so token limits are raised. @maya-cs can you file?

maya-cs: Filed: https://inbox.redwood/requests/ATLAS-priming-quota — requested +30% quota for the run window.

ops-bot: deploy: reserved-pool/atlas-priming v1.3 -> success (6 nodes), 1876543240

ben-platform: Also scheduling a preflight smoke 1h before priming to verify networking and auth. Opsbot will post results.

julian-customer: One ask from Atlas: please capture a short post-run summary focused on token burn, p95/p99, and any cost anomalies — we’ll need that for renewal health report.

anika-ml: Will attach evals and diff against baseline prompts.

sam-eng: Running a dry-run today at 16:00 PST (low-impact). If that looks good, proceed tomorrow 08:00.

maya-cs: Perfect. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when you’ve completed your preflight action items (quota confirm / script ready / cache seeding scheduled)? I’ll consolidate into the onboarding checklist.

julian-customer: :thumbsup:

ben-platform: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: smoke-test: network check OK, auth OK, sample generate latencies p95=210ms, p99=480ms, 1876543288

sam-eng: All scripts in repo: https://git.redwood/atlas/priming-loads (script: priming_staged.yaml).

maya-cs: Closing loop — I’ll post the final runbook and post-mortem template after the test. Thanks team, staying on standby. :raised_hands:
